decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module has its own page and was newly developed for the modular platform, so the firm's investment and its stated direction of expanding sensor modules favor keeping it.
The firm publicly announced this voltage module as the replacement for the previous generation, so it is central to the hardware-generation roadmap and very unlikely to be dropped.
The MQTT proxy extends the software bindings the firm promotes as a core strength, and keeping it costs little.

The CAN bus module is only mentioned rather than presented on its own page, but it fits the firm's connectivity direction and its development cost is already sunk, so weak early results can be attributed to the launch ramp-up.
The CO2 sensor module has a dedicated page and follows the firm's sensor-expansion strategy, so continued commitment is expected.
The touch panel accessory is a visible complement to the platform, and the firm's commitment to its ecosystem makes dropping it within a year unlikely.
